subtopics.title: Agent Definition and Core Concepts
subtopics.summary: Defines an agent as an entity that perceives its environment through sensors and acts upon it through actuators, distinguishing agentic patterns from simple retrieval by enabling autonomous action-taking and decision-making.

subtopics.title: Agent Tools
subtopics.summary: Covers the external capabilities and interfaces that agents use to interact with the world, extending model functionality beyond text generation to include API calls, code execution, and other action-taking mechanisms.

subtopics.title: Agent Planning
subtopics.summary: Explores how agents decompose tasks, sequence actions, and make autonomous decisions to solve complex problems, representing the cognitive layer that directs tool usage toward goal completion.

subtopics.title: Agent Failure Modes
subtopics.summary: Discusses the new modes of failure introduced by agentic operations, including error propagation in multi-step reasoning, tool misuse, and infinite loops, which differ from standard generation failures.
